answers.description: We make fitted wardrobes, alcove units and kitchens by hand in our Leeds workshop for homes across West Yorkshire. Every piece is measured, drawn and fitted by the two of us, and we only take on a few jobs a month so each one gets our full attention.

items.title: Fitted wardrobes
items.body: Made by hand in our Leeds workshop, measured and fitted to your room.

items.title: Alcove units
items.body: Designed and built to fit your alcoves exactly, made by hand.

items.title: Kitchens
items.body: Handmade kitchens, measured, drawn and fitted by the two of us.
